title: Tenpenny Wellness Wednesday
text:
The goal of our Wellness Wednesday is to highlight a few key updates worth your attention:
Education matters: What are you not being told about vaccines? Dr. Tenpenny’s courses break down the research behind the headlines.
The Tenpenny Report: What happens when we take a closer look at measles, Fauci, and fear-based narratives shaping public perception?
Dr. T’s Health Tip: What if one of the simplest steps for better health starts in your gut? Why probiotics may be a foundational piece of overall wellness.
The gut’s role in recovery: Could your microbiome be the missing link in how the body heals after a health setback?
There is far more behind each of these stories than the headlines reveal.
Read today’s Wellness Wednesday Newsletter at:https://DrTenpenny.com/wellnesswednesday
Podcast Guide for the Week: What if you had access to daily insights and uncensored health conversations every day?
PLUS AN EXCLUSIVE INVITE:
What would you ask if you could speak directly with a leading expert on autism and vaccine injury? Join the exclusive live masterclass on August 31 with Dr. Elizabeth Mumper — including a live Q&A on overlooked medical clues.
I am so pleased that Dr. Elizabeth Mumper is joining me for the August 31 Ask the Expert Masterclass on Autism and Vaccine Injury.
MEET DR. ELIZABETH MUMPER
Elizabeth Mumper, MD, FAAP, IFMCP is a board-certified pediatrician and founder and CEO of the Rimland Center for Integrative Medicine, with decades of experience in pediatric medicine, medical education and the care of children with autism.
For 5 years she was Medical Director of the Autism Research Institute, spent more than a decade as Director of Pediatric Education at the Lynchburg Family Practice Residency Program, and held a clinical faculty appointment at the University of Virginia for 16 years.
For this masterclass, she brings something especially valuable: years of direct clinical experience examining the medical problems that can exist alongside an autism diagnosis and asking what may still deserve investigation.
Reserve your spot TODAY.
